_comment: The parts of the venue parking pages that go out of date: prices, rules, event trains and the day each venue was last confirmed. The weekly venue-parking-prices routine reads every `verify` source, confirms each line, and changes this file only through scripts/venues/facts.mjs. Everything else about a venue (garages, walk times, stations) is in src/lib/venues.ts. After 45 days without a confirm, a page says its prices may be out of date.
